item.name: Common Chest
item.obtainment: Drops from any mob.
item.use: Opens for 1,000 to 2,500 Coins and 7 to 15 Gems.
item.cardSummary: The basic combat chest. Kill anything and you can walk away with a small coin and gem payout.

item.name: Uncommon Chest
item.obtainment: Drops from any mob.
item.use: Opens for 3,000 to 6,000 Coins and 25 to 50 Gems.
item.cardSummary: A step up from Common. Same mob farm, better coin and gem ranges.

item.name: Rare Chest
item.obtainment: Drops from any mob.
item.use: Opens for 10,000 to 20,000 Coins, 100 to 125 Gems, and one bonus item from Haki Color Reroll, Summon Core, Reroll Essence, Trait Reroll, or Race Reroll.
item.cardSummary: The first chest that also hands you a reroll or Summon Core every time you open it.

item.name: Epic Chest
item.obtainment: Drops from any mob and from bosses.
item.use: Opens for 30,000 to 60,000 Coins, 150 to 300 Gems, and one bonus stack of 1 to 2 Haki Color Rerolls or Summon Cores, or 1 Reroll Essence, Trait Reroll, or Race Reroll.
item.cardSummary: Bosses drop this far more often than trash mobs. Open it for a bigger payout plus a guaranteed bonus material.

item.name: Legendary Chest
item.obtainment: Drops from any mob and from bosses.
item.use: Opens for 80,000 to 150,000 Coins, 500 to 800 Gems, and 1 or 2 bonus items from the reroll and Summon Core pool.
item.cardSummary: A late-farm chest. Boss kills are the realistic way to see these and the extra rerolls inside.

item.name: Mythical Chest
item.obtainment: Drops from any mob and from bosses.
item.use: Opens for 200,000 to 350,000 Coins, 900 to 1,100 Gems, and 2 or 3 bonus items, including up to 3 Haki Color Rerolls or Summon Cores.
item.cardSummary: The rarest chest. Bosses still only drop it at 1%, but the bonus pile is the biggest in the set.

item.name: Common Ore
item.obtainment: Destroy the Huge Stone world event on Dawnwind Village. It spawns every 20 minutes, despawns after 5 minutes, and gives 1 random ore for every 1% damage you deal.
item.use: Used to enchant weapons.
item.cardSummary: The most common Huge Stone payout. Break the stone on the starter island, then spend the ore on weapon enchants.

item.name: Uncommon Ore
item.obtainment: Destroy the Huge Stone world event on Dawnwind Village. It spawns every 20 minutes, despawns after 5 minutes, and gives 1 random ore for every 1% damage you deal.
item.use: Used to enchant weapons.
item.cardSummary: A mid-tier Huge Stone ore. Same event as the other ores, better than Common for enchants.

item.name: Rare Ore
item.obtainment: Destroy the Huge Stone world event on Dawnwind Village. It spawns every 20 minutes, despawns after 5 minutes, and gives 1 random ore for every 1% damage you deal.
item.use: Used to enchant weapons.
item.cardSummary: A stronger Huge Stone roll. Show up every 20 minutes on Dawnwind Village and chip the stone down.

item.name: Epic Ore
item.obtainment: Destroy the Huge Stone world event on Dawnwind Village. It spawns every 20 minutes, despawns after 5 minutes, and gives 1 random ore for every 1% damage you deal.
item.use: Used to enchant weapons.
item.cardSummary: A high-tier enchant ore from the same Huge Stone loop as the rest of the set.

item.name: Legendary Ore
item.obtainment: Destroy the Huge Stone world event on Dawnwind Village. It spawns every 20 minutes, despawns after 5 minutes, and gives 1 random ore for every 1% damage you deal.
item.use: Used to enchant weapons.
item.cardSummary: A rare Huge Stone ore. Private-server damage on the stone is the clean way to stock these.

item.name: Mythical Ore
item.obtainment: Destroy the Huge Stone world event on Dawnwind Village. It spawns every 20 minutes, despawns after 5 minutes, and gives 1 random ore for every 1% damage you deal.
item.use: Used to enchant weapons.
item.cardSummary: One of the top Huge Stone rolls. Same 20-minute Dawnwind spawn as every other ore.

item.name: Lineage Ore
item.obtainment: Destroy the Huge Stone world event on Dawnwind Village. It spawns every 20 minutes, despawns after 5 minutes, and gives 1 random ore for every 1% damage you deal.
item.use: Used to enchant weapons.
item.cardSummary: The top-named ore on the Trello list. It still comes from Huge Stone, not from mobs or chests.

item.name: Trial's Key
item.obtainment: Buy from the Portal Key Seller on Scorched Ruins for 1 Boss's Soul plus 75,000 Coins or 750 Gems.
item.use: Opens artifact trial portals.
item.cardSummary: The paid portal key. Spend a Boss's Soul at Scorched Ruins when you are ready to farm artifacts.

item.name: Cid's Key
item.obtainment: Drops from Bandits on Dawnwind Village. The Tower Shop on Monument Isle also sells it for 8 Tower Shards.
item.use: Opens Cid's Castle.
item.cardSummary: Your ticket into Cid's Castle for Shadow materials. Farm starter-island Bandits or spend Tower Shards.

item.name: Shrine Key
item.obtainment: Drops from Snow Bandits on Frostborn Island. The Tower Shop on Monument Isle also sells it for 5 Tower Shards.
item.use: Opens the Plane of Euthymia raid for Raiden materials.
item.cardSummary: The Raiden raid key. Snow Bandits on Frostborn are the combat farm, Tower Shards are the pity buy.

item.name: Cartenon Key
item.obtainment: Drops from Sung Jinwoo on Fossil Island.
item.use: Opens Cartenon Temple for Shadow Monarch materials.
item.cardSummary: Sung Jinwoo almost always drops one. Use it to enter Cartenon Temple and hunt Monarch mats.

item.name: Absolute Ether Key
item.obtainment: Obtained from the Miyabi banner at Lineage Town.
item.use: Opens Absolute Dead End for the Miyabi fight.
item.cardSummary: The Miyabi dungeon key. Pull it from the Lineage Town banner, then run Absolute Dead End.

item.name: Scatthen Key
item.obtainment: Finish the Scatthen Key quest on Hueco Mundo (500 Quincy kills, 25 Aizen kills, and 4 Reishi Crystals with Observation Haki). After that, Quincy can drop the key.
item.use: Opens Wandenreich for the Yhwach raid.
item.cardSummary: Yhwach's door key. Clear the Hueco Mundo quest first or Quincy will not start dropping it.

item.name: Ryuudo Key
item.obtainment: Drops from Saber in Legend's Arena.
item.use: Opens Ryuudo Cave for the Saber Alter route.
item.cardSummary: Farm Saber, then use the key to reach Medusa, Corruption, and Saber Alter.

item.name: Glamoth Planet Key
item.obtainment: Buy from the Byte Shop on Monument Isle for 500 Bytes.
item.use: Opens Glamoth Planet for Firefly materials.
item.cardSummary: Spend Simulated Sea Bytes on Monument Isle, then run Glamoth Planet for Firefly mats and Armor Scrap.

item.name: Butterfly Grave Key
item.obtainment: Buy from the Butterfly Shop on Frostborn Island for 35 Soulweaver Butterflies.
item.use: Opens The Butterfly Grave dungeon.
item.cardSummary: Angela's shop key. Bank Soulweaver Butterflies on Frostborn, then open Butterfly Grave for Solemn Lament parts.

item.name: Haki Color Reroll
item.obtainment: Drops from Rare Chests or higher, and from any mob or boss.
item.use: Rerolls your Armament Haki color at the color system. Color is cosmetic only.
item.cardSummary: A cosmetic Armament reroll. Farm Rare+ chests or the 4% combat pool if you hate your first aura color.

item.name: Race Reroll
item.obtainment: Drops from Rare Chests or higher, and from any mob or boss. The Armor Scrap Shop and Byte Shop on Monument Isle also sell it.
item.use: Rerolls your race at the Race Reroll NPC in Lineage Town.
item.cardSummary: The standard race spin. Chests, combat, Armor Scrap, and Bytes all feed this NPC in Lineage Town.

item.name: Trait Reroll
item.obtainment: Drops from Rare Chests or higher, and from any mob or boss. The Armor Scrap Shop and Byte Shop on Monument Isle also sell it.
item.use: Rerolls your trait at the Trait Reroll NPC in Lineage Town.
item.cardSummary: Same farm as Race Reroll, different NPC. Use it when you are chasing a better trait roll.

item.name: Reroll Essence
item.obtainment: Drops from Rare Chests or higher, and from any mob or boss. The Armor Scrap Shop and Byte Shop on Monument Isle also sell it.
item.use: Rerolls stats at the Stats Potential NPC in Lineage Town.
item.cardSummary: The stat-board reroll. Hold these until you know which potential you are pushing.

item.name: Artifact Sub-Reroll
item.obtainment: Exchanged from Simulated Sea, including a 10,000-point Simulated Sea reward. The Byte Shop also sells it for 1,000 Bytes, and the Armor Scrap Shop sells it for 50 Armor Scrap.
item.use: Rerolls artifact sub-stats.
item.cardSummary: Not a combat drop. Run Simulated Sea or buy it with Bytes or Armor Scrap when you are tuning artifact rolls.

item.name: Haki Book
item.obtainment: Drops from any mob or boss.
item.use: Hand in at the Buso Haki NPC on Frostborn Island to unlock Armament Haki.
item.cardSummary: The Armament book. It is a 0.1% combat drop and is not the same item as the Observation quest book.

item.name: Obs Haki Book
item.obtainment: Granted automatically after you light the fifth Observation Haki torch on the Deeproot Jungle quest.
item.use: Hand in at the Observation Haki trainer with 2.5 million Yen to unlock Observation Haki. The book is untradeable and one-time.
item.cardSummary: A quest-only Observation book. You cannot farm or trade this the way you farm the Armament Haki Book.

item.name: Sword Technique Book
item.obtainment: Drops from sword bosses. Sung Jinwoo and Saber both drop it.
item.use: Required to buy Player's Dagger and Excalibur.
item.cardSummary: The shared sword-unlock book. Farm Sung Jinwoo if you want the better listed chance.

item.name: Limitless Scroll
item.obtainment: Exchanged at the Limitless Scroll Seller on Shinjuku Showdown after the Gojo Shinjuku mastery quests, for 50 Cursed Shards, 2 Infinity Cores, and 5 Limitless Shards.
item.use: Unlocks Gojo Shinjuku mastery moves.
item.cardSummary: A crafted mastery scroll, not a world drop. Finish the Shinjuku Gojo quests, then pay the shard cost.

item.name: Shrine Scroll
item.obtainment: Exchanged at the Shrine Scroll Seller on Shinjuku Showdown after the Sukuna Shinjuku mastery quests, for 50 Cursed Shards, 2 Slash Cores, and 5 Shrine Shards.
item.use: Unlocks Sukuna Shinjuku mastery moves.
item.cardSummary: Sukuna Shinjuku's mastery scroll. Same island as Limitless Scroll, different seller and materials.

item.name: Summon Core
item.obtainment: Drops from Rare Chests or higher, and from any mob or boss.
item.use: Spent at the Boss Summoner in Legend's Arena. Verdant Hero costs 2 Summon Cores and 350 Gems. Saber costs 2 Summon Cores and 500 Gems.
item.cardSummary: The Legend's Arena summon token. Save stacks for Deku and Saber spawns instead of opening them like chests.

item.name: Boss's Soul
item.obtainment: Drops once per Legend's Arena boss kill.
item.use: Spent at the Boss Exchange in Legend's Arena and at the Portal Key Seller for Trial's Keys. Solemn Lament also asks for 250.
item.cardSummary: Legend's Arena pity currency. Trade it for keys, exchange rewards, or the Solemn Lament bill.

item.name: Ticket
item.obtainment: Earned from playtime rewards, Tower, the Merchant, Tower Shop, and shop products. Trello also notes a Ticket every 5 Tower floors.
item.use: Spent on the Lineage Town banner, including the Miyabi banner that can grant Absolute Ether Keys.
item.cardSummary: Banner fuel. Do playtime and Tower, then spend Tickets in Lineage Town instead of treating them like combat loot.

item.name: Tower Shard
item.obtainment: Drops from the Tower gamemode on Monument Isle.
item.use: Traded at the Tower Shop for dungeon keys, including 5 shards for a Shrine Key and 8 shards for a Cid's Key. Also used for Tower upgrades.
item.cardSummary: Tower's own currency. Climb floors, then buy Shrine or Cid keys when you do not want to farm the mobs.

item.name: Holy Grail
item.obtainment: Crafted at the Holy Grail Craft NPC in Legend's Arena for 5 Golden Dust.
item.use: Used to spawn Gilgamesh at the Boss Summoner.
item.cardSummary: Gilgamesh's spawn item. Turn Golden Dust into one Grail, then pay the rest of the summon cost.

item.name: Golden Dust
item.obtainment: Drops from any mob.
item.use: Exchanged 5 to 1 into a Holy Grail, which is required to spawn Gilgamesh.
item.cardSummary: A common-looking dust with one job: five of these become a Holy Grail in Legend's Arena.

item.name: Slime
item.obtainment: Drops from Rimuru on Fossil Island.
item.use: Consumed to roll the Slime race at a 5% success chance.
item.cardSummary: Rimuru's race item. You will burn several of these before the Slime race actually sticks.

item.name: Frozen Sakura
item.use: Consumed to roll the Frost Kitsune race at a 10% success chance.
item.cardSummary: The Miyabi race item. Official Trello lists the race use, but not where the sakura itself drops.

item.name: Black heart
item.use: Consumed to obtain the Monarch race.
item.cardSummary: The Monarch race consumable for Shadow's Dagger builds. Trello does not list a drop source.

item.name: Demon Soul
item.cardSummary: A named Trello item in the Kokushibo group. Official cards do not yet list a drop or a spend.

item.name: Blue Spider Lily
item.obtainment: Spawns in the world on Fossil Island, Shinjuku Showdown, Lineage Town, Deeproot Jungle, and Legend's Arena.
item.use: Hand in 10 at the Muzan race NPC to unlock the Demon race.
item.cardSummary: A world spawn, not a boss drop. Sweep the five listed islands, then pay Muzan 10 lilies for Demon.

item.name: Hollow Mask
item.obtainment: Drops from Ichigo (Bankai) on Hueco Mundo.
item.use: Required to buy Tensa Zangetsu after you own Zangetsu and have killed Ichigo (Bankai) 50 times.
item.cardSummary: A Tensa unlock material, not an accessory. The drop is tiny, so plan a long Bankai farm.

item.name: Cursed Orb
item.obtainment: Drops from Sorcerer Students and Miwa at Jujutsu High School.
item.use: Spent at the Sorcerer Summoner to spawn Gojo and Sukuna.
item.cardSummary: Jujutsu summon bait. Miwa is the faster orb farm if you can kill her on cooldown.

item.name: Cursed Shard
item.obtainment: Drops from Jujutsu bosses, including Gojo, Sukuna, and both Shinjuku versions.
item.use: Required for Gojo (x15), Sukuna (x15), Gojo Shinjuku (x100), Sukuna Shinjuku (x100), and both Shinjuku mastery scrolls (x50 each).
item.dropChance: 35% from Gojo or Sukuna, 50% from Shinjuku bosses
item.cardSummary: The shared Jujutsu tax. You need a lot of these for both base styles and the Shinjuku upgrades.

item.name: Six Eye
item.obtainment: Drops from Gojo at Jujutsu High School.
item.use: Required to buy Gojo. The NPC asks for 2.
item.cardSummary: Gojo's rare eye drop. You need two, so expect a long Sorcerer Summoner loop.

item.name: Infinity Essence
item.obtainment: Drops from Gojo at Jujutsu High School.
item.use: Required to buy Gojo. The NPC asks for 8.
item.cardSummary: The common Gojo material. Farm this alongside Six Eye and Cursed Shards.

item.name: Sukuna's Finger
item.obtainment: Drops from Sukuna at Jujutsu High School.
item.use: Required to buy Sukuna. The NPC asks for 20.
item.cardSummary: Sukuna's named drop. Twenty fingers is a long summon farm even at 15%.

item.name: True six eye
item.obtainment: Drops from Gojo Shinjuku at Shinjuku Showdown.
item.use: Required to buy Gojo Shinjuku (x1) and to unlock the Enlightened race (x2).
item.cardSummary: The Shinjuku Gojo eye. One buys the style, two more are burned for Enlightened.

item.name: Infinity Core
item.obtainment: Drops from Gojo Shinjuku at Shinjuku Showdown.
item.use: Required to buy Gojo Shinjuku (x1) and to exchange a Limitless Scroll (x2).
item.cardSummary: Shinjuku Gojo's core. Keep extras for the Limitless Scroll after you buy the style.

item.name: Limitless Shard
item.obtainment: Drops from Gojo Shinjuku at Shinjuku Showdown.
item.use: Required to buy Gojo Shinjuku (x5) and to exchange a Limitless Scroll (x5).
item.cardSummary: The bulk Shinjuku Gojo shard. You will need a second set of five for mastery.

item.name: True Sukuna Fingers
item.obtainment: Drops from Sukuna Shinjuku at Shinjuku Showdown.
item.use: Required to buy Sukuna Shinjuku (x5) and to unlock the Vessel race (x20).
item.cardSummary: Shinjuku Sukuna's finger pile. Five unlock the style, twenty more buy Vessel.

item.name: Slash Core
item.obtainment: Drops from Sukuna Shinjuku at Shinjuku Showdown.
item.use: Required to buy Sukuna Shinjuku (x1) and to exchange a Shrine Scroll (x2).
item.cardSummary: The rare Shinjuku Sukuna core. Save at least three if you want both the style and mastery.

item.name: Shrine Shard
item.obtainment: Drops from Sukuna Shinjuku at Shinjuku Showdown.
item.use: Required to buy Sukuna Shinjuku (x5) and to exchange a Shrine Scroll (x5).
item.cardSummary: Sukuna Shinjuku's bulk shard. Same double-tax as Limitless Shard.

item.name: Slime Essence
item.obtainment: Drops from Rimuru on Fossil Island.
item.use: Required to buy Rimuru. The NPC asks for 10.
item.cardSummary: Rimuru's common material. You still need Slime race, a Shizu Mask, and seven Slime Cores with it.

item.name: Slime Orb
item.obtainment: Drops from Hollows and Arrancars on Hueco Mundo. The Book Exchange on Fossil Island also trades for it.
item.use: Given to the Slime Summoner so Rimuru spawns instead of Sung Jinwoo. The orb is consumed each summon.
item.cardSummary: Rimuru's spawn item. Farm Hueco Mundo or use the Fossil Island book trader, then spend one orb per spawn.

item.name: Slime Core
item.obtainment: Drops from Rimuru on Fossil Island.
item.use: Required to buy Rimuru. The NPC asks for 7.
item.cardSummary: The harder Rimuru material. Seven cores is the long part of that Fossil Island buy.

item.name: Shizu Mask
item.obtainment: Drops from Rimuru on Fossil Island.
item.use: Required to buy Rimuru. The NPC asks for 1.
item.cardSummary: A Rimuru unlock material, not Rimuru's Outfit. One mask, very low drop.

item.name: One for all's Cell
item.obtainment: Drops from Deku in Legend's Arena.
item.use: Required to buy Verdant Hero. The NPC asks for 9.
item.cardSummary: Deku's only style material. Summon him in Legend's Arena until you have nine cells.

item.name: Knight Killer
item.obtainment: Drops from Sung Jinwoo on Fossil Island.
item.use: Required to buy Player's Dagger. The NPC asks for 1, plus Venom Fang, System Cores, and a Sword Technique Book.
item.cardSummary: One of the two Sung dagger pieces. Pair it with Venom Fang at the Scorched Ruins NPC.

item.name: Venom Fang
item.obtainment: Drops from Sung Jinwoo on Fossil Island.
item.use: Required to buy Player's Dagger. The NPC asks for 1.
item.cardSummary: The other Sung dagger piece. Same boss, same 3.5% as Knight Killer.

item.name: System Core
item.obtainment: Drops from Sung Jinwoo on Fossil Island.
item.use: Required to buy Player's Dagger. The NPC asks for 5.
item.cardSummary: Sung's bulk material. Five cores plus the two named fangs unlock Player's Dagger.

item.name: Goblet
item.obtainment: Drops from Saber in Legend's Arena.
item.use: Required to buy Excalibur. The NPC asks for 5.
item.cardSummary: Saber's common Excalibur material. You still need Avalon and a Sword Technique Book.

item.name: Avalon
item.obtainment: Drops from Saber in Legend's Arena.
item.use: Required to buy Excalibur. The NPC asks for 1.
item.cardSummary: The rare Saber piece. One Avalon gates the whole Excalibur purchase.

item.name: Black Slime
item.obtainment: Drops from any mob in Cid's Castle.
item.use: Required to buy Shadow. The NPC asks for 100.
item.cardSummary: Shadow's trash-farm material. Clear Cid's Castle waves, not just the final boss.

item.name: Shadow Fragment
item.obtainment: Drops from the Shadow boss in Cid's Castle.
item.use: Required to buy Shadow. The NPC asks for 6.
item.cardSummary: A Cid's Castle boss drop. Six fragments sit between you and the Shadow weapon.

item.name: Shadow Orb
item.obtainment: Drops from the Shadow boss in Cid's Castle.
item.use: Required to buy Shadow. The NPC asks for 12.
item.cardSummary: The bulk Shadow boss drop. Twelve orbs plus fragments, cores, and Black Slime finish the buy.

item.name: Atomic Core
item.obtainment: Drops from the Shadow boss in Cid's Castle.
item.use: Required to buy Shadow. The NPC asks for 2.
item.cardSummary: Shadow's rare core. Two of these are the stingy part of the Frostborn purchase.

item.name: Celestial Steel
item.obtainment: Drops in the Plane of Euthymia raid opened with a Shrine Key.
item.use: Required to buy Raiden. The NPC asks for 40.
item.cardSummary: Raiden's bulk steel. Forty pieces is a long Plane of Euthymia loop even at 35%.

item.name: Tear of Eternity
item.obtainment: Drops in the Plane of Euthymia raid opened with a Shrine Key.
item.use: Required to buy Raiden. The NPC asks for 5.
item.cardSummary: A mid-rare Raiden drop. Farm it on the same Shrine Key runs as Celestial Steel.

item.name: Shard of Calamity
item.obtainment: Drops in the Plane of Euthymia raid opened with a Shrine Key.
item.use: Required to buy Raiden. The NPC asks for 5.
item.cardSummary: Matches Tear of Eternity on rate and count. Same raid, same Raiden bill.

item.name: Electro Vision
item.obtainment: Drops in the Plane of Euthymia raid opened with a Shrine Key.
item.use: Required to buy Raiden. The NPC asks for 1.
item.cardSummary: Raiden's rare vision. One copy, 1% chance, same dungeon as the steel.

item.name: Puppet Core
item.obtainment: Drops in the Plane of Euthymia raid opened with a Shrine Key.
item.use: Required to buy Raiden. The NPC asks for 2.
item.cardSummary: The other rare Raiden core. You need two, so plan extra Shrine Key runs.

item.name: Hogyoku
item.obtainment: Drops from Aizen on Hueco Mundo as Hogyoku Shard.
item.use: Required to buy Aizen. The NPC asks for 1, plus True Shinigami.
item.cardSummary: Aizen's named core. Trello's item is Hogyoku even though the boss card says Hogyoku Shard.

item.name: Shattered Soul
item.obtainment: Drops from Aizen on Hueco Mundo.
item.use: Required to buy Aizen. The NPC asks for 5.
item.cardSummary: A mid-rare Aizen drop. Spawn him through the Hollow-kill summoner on Hueco Mundo.

item.name: Formless Mirror
item.obtainment: Drops from Aizen on Hueco Mundo.
item.use: Required to buy Aizen. The NPC asks for 10.
item.cardSummary: Aizen's bulk rare. Ten mirrors plus souls, silk, and a Hogyoku finish the buy.

item.name: Reishi Core
item.obtainment: Drops from Aizen on Hueco Mundo.
item.use: Required to buy Aizen. The NPC asks for 30.
item.cardSummary: Aizen's common core. Thirty is a lot of summons even at 50%.

item.name: Void Silk
item.obtainment: Drops from Aizen on Hueco Mundo.
item.use: Required to buy Aizen. The NPC asks for 35.
item.cardSummary: The most common Aizen drop. You still need 35 of them for the Hueco Mundo NPC.

item.name: Genesis core
item.obtainment: Drops from Gilgamesh in Legend's Arena.
item.use: Required to buy Gilgamesh. The NPC asks for 1 and the King of Heroes title.
item.cardSummary: Gilgamesh's rare core. Spawn him with a Holy Grail, then hope this 0.85% lands.

item.name: Babylon Fragment
item.obtainment: Drops from Gilgamesh in Legend's Arena.
item.use: Required to buy Gilgamesh. The NPC asks for 4.
item.cardSummary: A mid-rare Gilgamesh fragment. Four copies ride along with the Genesis core farm.

item.name: Tyrant's Crest
item.obtainment: Drops from Gilgamesh in Legend's Arena.
item.use: Required to buy Gilgamesh. The NPC asks for 7.
item.cardSummary: Gilgamesh's crest drop. Seven crests plus fragments, essence, and the core unlock the style.

item.name: Golden Essence
item.obtainment: Drops from Gilgamesh in Legend's Arena.
item.use: Required to buy Gilgamesh. The NPC asks for 20.
item.cardSummary: The common Gilgamesh material. Twenty essences is the volume grind on that summon.

item.name: Frost Katana Tsuba
item.obtainment: Drops from Miyabi in Absolute Dead End.
item.use: Required for Miyabi mastery. The Monument Isle mastery NPC asks for 1.
item.cardSummary: Miyabi's mastery part. Open Absolute Dead End with an Absolute Ether Key, then grab one tsuba.

item.name: Monarch's Soul
item.obtainment: Drops from Shadow Monarch in Cartenon Temple.
item.use: Required to buy Shadow's Daggers. The NPC asks for 1.
item.cardSummary: The rare Cartenon soul. One copy is the last named material on the Shadow Daggers bill.

item.name: Core of Shadow
item.obtainment: Drops from Shadow Monarch in Cartenon Temple.
item.use: Required to buy Shadow's Daggers. The NPC asks for 2.
item.cardSummary: Cartenon's second named core. Farm it on the same key runs as Monarch's Soul.

item.name: Gate Fragment
item.use: Required to buy Shadow's Daggers. The NPC asks for 10.
item.cardSummary: Shadow Daggers needs ten of these. Official Trello lists the spend, not the drop.

item.name: Nichirin blue print
item.obtainment: Drops from Kokushibo in Legend's Arena.
item.use: Required to buy Kokushibo. The NPC asks for 1 and Demon race.
item.cardSummary: Kokushibo's blueprint. Get Demon from Muzan first, then spend this with flutes and eyes.

item.name: Broken Flute
item.obtainment: Drops from Kokushibo in Legend's Arena.
item.use: Required to buy Kokushibo. The NPC asks for 4.
item.cardSummary: A Kokushibo material. Four flutes sit next to the blueprint and Upper One Eyes.

item.name: Upper One Eye
item.obtainment: Drops from Kokushibo in Legend's Arena.
item.use: Required to buy Kokushibo. The NPC asks for 6.
item.cardSummary: Kokushibo's eye pile. Six copies are the volume grind on that Legend's Arena summon.

item.name: Eye of the Almighty
item.obtainment: Drops from Yhwach in Wandenreich.
item.use: Required to buy Yhwach. The NPC asks for 3 and Quincy race.
item.cardSummary: Yhwach's rarest listed drop. Open Wandenreich with a Scatthen Key, then hunt three eyes.

item.name: Angel Halo
item.obtainment: Drops from Lille Barro in Wandenreich.
item.use: Required to buy Yhwach. The NPC asks for 5.
item.cardSummary: A Wandenreich mini-boss drop. Clear the five crosses before you even see Yhwach.

item.name: Bomb Core
item.obtainment: Drops from Bambietta in Wandenreich.
item.use: Required to buy Yhwach. The NPC asks for 5.
item.cardSummary: Another Wandenreich mini-boss piece. Five cores are on the same Yhwach receipt.

item.name: Miracle Core
item.obtainment: Drops from Gerard Valkyrie in Wandenreich.
item.use: Required to buy Yhwach. The NPC asks for 5.
item.cardSummary: Gerard's Wandenreich drop. Same 1.25% as the other Sternritter pieces.

item.name: Poison Vial
item.obtainment: Drops from Askin Nakk Le Vaar in Wandenreich.
item.use: Required to buy Yhwach. The NPC asks for 5.
item.cardSummary: Askin's Wandenreich vial. Farm the crosses, then spend five vials on Yhwach.

item.name: Silver Shield
item.obtainment: Drops from Jugram Haschwalth in Wandenreich.
item.use: Required to buy Yhwach. The NPC asks for 5.
item.cardSummary: Jugram's shield drop. It is a Yhwach material, not an accessory.

item.name: Quincy Cross
item.obtainment: Drops from Yhwach in Wandenreich.
item.use: Required to buy Yhwach. The NPC asks for 10.
item.cardSummary: Yhwach's own cross drop. Ten copies plus the Sternritter set unlock the style.

item.name: Blue Soul
item.obtainment: Drops from Wandenreich mini-bosses and from Yhwach.
item.use: Required to buy Yhwach. The NPC asks for 400.
item.cardSummary: Yhwach's volume tax. Four hundred souls is why people live in Wandenreich.

item.name: Corrupted Holy Sword
item.obtainment: Drops from Saber Alter in Ryuudo Cave.
item.use: Required to buy Saber Alter / Excalibur Morgan. The NPC asks for 1.
item.cardSummary: The rare Saber Alter sword. Open Ryuudo Cave, beat Medusa and Corruption, then hope for 1%.

item.name: Dark Mana Core
item.obtainment: Drops from Saber Alter in Ryuudo Cave.
item.use: Required to buy Saber Alter. The NPC asks for 3.
item.cardSummary: A mid-rare Saber Alter core. Three copies ride on the same Ryuudo Cave loop.

item.name: Servant Covenant
item.obtainment: Drops from Medusa in Ryuudo Cave.
item.use: Required to buy Saber Alter. The NPC asks for 5.
item.cardSummary: Medusa's covenant drop. Farm it before the Saber Alter spawn, not after.

item.name: Dragon Blood
item.obtainment: Drops from Saber Alter in Ryuudo Cave.
item.use: Required to buy Saber Alter. The NPC asks for 10.
item.cardSummary: Saber Alter's common material. Ten bloods plus the rare sword finish Excalibur Morgan.

item.name: Grail Mud
item.obtainment: Drops from Corruption in Ryuudo Cave.
item.use: Required to buy Saber Alter. The NPC asks for 750.
item.cardSummary: The huge Saber Alter pile. Survive Corruption for 60 seconds and scoop mud every run.

item.name: Molten Core
item.obtainment: Drops from Proto-SAM Type-III and Fyrefly Type-IV on Glamoth Planet.
item.use: Required to buy Firefly. The NPC asks for 1 and Glamoth race.
item.cardSummary: Firefly's rare core. Fyrefly Type-IV is the better listed chance of the two Glamoth bosses.

item.name: Shaper
item.obtainment: Drops from Proto-SAM Type-III and Fyrefly Type-IV on Glamoth Planet.
item.use: Required to buy Firefly. The NPC asks for 3.
item.cardSummary: A Glamoth Planet drop. Three Shapers sit on the Firefly receipt with Will and valves.

item.name: Firefly's Will
item.obtainment: Drops from Proto-SAM Type-III and Fyrefly Type-IV on Glamoth Planet.
item.use: Required to buy Firefly. The NPC asks for 6.
item.cardSummary: Firefly's named will drop. Six copies come from the same Glamoth Planet key runs.

item.name: Ignition Valve
item.obtainment: Drops from Proto-SAM Type-III and Fyrefly Type-IV on Glamoth Planet.
item.use: Required to buy Firefly. The NPC asks for 9.
item.cardSummary: The bulk Firefly valve. Nine valves plus scrap and a Molten Core unlock the style.

item.name: Glamoth Essence
item.use: Consumed to roll the Glamoth race at a 10% success chance. The Armor Scrap Shop also takes it for 50 Armor Scrap.
item.cardSummary: Firefly's race item. Trello lists the race use and a shop exchange, not a boss drop rate.

item.name: Armor Scrap
item.obtainment: Obtained from the Glamoth Planet dungeon.
item.use: Required to buy Firefly (x250). Also spent at the Armor Scrap Shop for Dreamscape, Oak Cake Roll, Glamoth Essence, and rerolls.
item.cardSummary: Glamoth Planet scrap. Two hundred fifty buy Firefly, and extras feed the Monument Isle scrap shop.

item.name: Oak Cake Roll
item.use: Exchanged at the Armor Scrap Shop on Monument Isle for 150 Armor Scrap.
item.cardSummary: A Firefly-group Trello item with a shop sink. Official cards do not list where the cake itself drops.

item.name: Dreamscape
item.use: Exchanged at the Armor Scrap Shop on Monument Isle for 125 Armor Scrap.
item.cardSummary: Another scrap-shop sink from the Firefly group. Keep it if you need Armor Scrap, not Firefly itself.

item.name: Grief for the dead
item.obtainment: Crafted at the Butterfly Shop on Frostborn Island from White Gun Parts 1, 2, and 3.
item.use: Required to buy Solemn Lament. The NPC asks for 1.
item.cardSummary: One of Solemn Lament's two finished gun parts. Assemble the white set at Angela's shop.

item.name: Lament for the living
item.obtainment: Crafted at the Butterfly Shop on Frostborn Island from Black Gun Parts 1, 2, and 3.
item.use: Required to buy Solemn Lament. The NPC asks for 1.
item.cardSummary: The black Solemn Lament half. Pair it with Grief, Fusion Cores, butterflies, and Boss's Souls.

item.name: Fusion Core
item.obtainment: Crafted at the Butterfly Shop on Frostborn Island for 20 Boss's Souls and 100 Soulweaver Butterflies.
item.use: Required to buy Solemn Lament. The NPC asks for 5.
item.cardSummary: A crafted Solemn Lament core. Five cores means 100 Boss's Souls and 500 butterflies if you craft every one.

item.name: Monochrome Wood
item.use: Spent at the Butterfly Shop with Invert Tears and Soulweaver Butterflies to craft A Large Coffin.
item.cardSummary: A Solemn Lament-group material with a coffin recipe. Official Trello does not list its drop.

item.name: Invert Tears
item.use: Spent at the Butterfly Shop with Monochrome Wood and Soulweaver Butterflies to craft A Large Coffin.
item.cardSummary: The other coffin ingredient. Same shop as Grief, Lament, and Fusion Cores.

item.name: Soulweaver Butterfly
item.obtainment: Drops from Butterflyed mobs and from The Butterfly Grave dungeon on Frostborn Island.
item.use: Required to buy Solemn Lament (x100). Also spent on Butterfly Grave Keys (x35), Fusion Cores (x100 each), and A Large Coffin (x500).
item.cardSummary: The Solemn Lament grind item. Kill Butterflyed mobs, run Butterfly Grave, then spend stacks at Angela's shop.
